notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Let me be clear here. Rose is not a good PvE weapon. It can exist within the PvE space with rapid hit and either vorpal weapon or explosive payload, but it is not a PvE oriented weapon." Recommended Grips - Grip: Smooth Grip, Polymer Grip, Combat Grip. Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Rose is the hotness if you’re into using hand cannons in the crucible. Being a stand-alone archetype of a relic long thought lost. Rose has the intrinsic lightweight bonus (+20 mobility) and it also has access to grips over an origin trait. The unique archetype will feel right at home with crucible affectionados and the grips can make up for some extra stats. Rose will excel if you bump up handling, stability and, most importantly, range. I would still not sacrifice other stats to make up for range, but if you happen to get more range I would take it." Recommended Grips - Grip: Smooth Grip, Polymer Grip, Combat Grip. Recommended MW - Range.
